description: cmix v21 forced text-mode wrapper using the mmap allocator plus PAQ8 level 9 instead of level 11. The binary and english.dic are gzip-compressed and counted toward program_size.
hypothesis: PAQ8 level 10 remained near or above the strict memory ceiling during verification. PAQ8 level 9 should clear memory while retaining enough of cmix21 text-mode's full-corpus margin to stay a plausible 10.95 candidate.
deps: C++ runtime for the vendored cmix binary
POSIX mmap and temporary filesystem space

memory_observation.source: ps RSS samples during the 1K driver gate

1k_driver_gate.notes: PAQ8 level 9 cleared the sampled 10 GiB resident-memory ceiling on both compression and decompression.

rejected_neighbors.cmix21_text_wrapped_v1: Unrestricted cmix21 text mode started with roughly 16169036 KiB RSS and is not memory-admissible.
rejected_neighbors.cmix21_text_mmap_wrapped_v1: Full PAQ8 level 11 plus mmap still sampled around 11980740 KiB RSS.
rejected_neighbors.cmix21_text_mmap_ppmd8g_v1: Reducing only PPMD did not reduce the binding resident memory; sampled around 12040392 KiB RSS.
rejected_neighbors.cmix21_text_mmap_paq10_v1: PAQ8 level 10 compression sampled near the ceiling, but decompression sampled around 10880384 KiB RSS.
rejected_neighbors.cmix21_text_mmap_paq10_ppmd8g_v1: Combined PAQ8 level 10 and PPMD 8000 MB later rose to around 11241668 KiB RSS during compression.

verdict: Best live frontier program found so far: 1K roundtrip passed with sampled compression/decompression RSS below 10 GiB. Not a 10.95 proof until it survives larger gates and full-corpus score accounting.
